status: Final G02 post-CR17 C control and decision rule; registered before any post-CR17 run
source: git archive of feature/stability-and-optimization aaa9ee5 server/app (tree e18855a1, equal to measured 22b); includes CR17 21b and 22+22b
source_scope_note: Fixture uses app.common.database Base, torrent_files repository/models/schemas and indexer models. Versus the C baseline source only additions differ (shared_read_session, TorrentFileSnapshot); engine/PRAGMA setup and touch/insert path unchanged. Static note, not a result.
resources: Same as v1 C/A/B: 2 CPU affinity 0,1, 1 GiB, local Docker Desktop npipe, network none, read-only source, disposable task-labelled local volume per run.
correctness: Per run: is_measurement, >=3600 s, 9 cells each >=400 s, zero errors, final pool checkouts 0, final checkpoint after all readers closed busy=0 and log==checkpointed. Any failure => INVALID (stop, report; no decision).
ordinary_path_rules: Cells short/1,4,8 and select-await/1,4,8. WAL reuse: wal_header_epochs >= max(2, floor(min(C_a,C_b)/2)). Commit and transaction p99 <= max(C_a,C_b)+|C_a-C_b| per cell. Ordinary-cell WAL high-water <= max ordinary high-water of C_a, C_b, A, B.
decision: NO_CHANGE if correctness holds and no ordinary rule fails in both runs for the same cell/metric: CR02 closes with measurement, no production PRAGMA/checkpoint change. PASSIVE_CANDIDATE if some ordinary rule fails in both runs (repeatable backlog/commit spike/storage): a separate CR02 candidate package is proposed; nothing is changed by this gate. Single-run failures are reported as noise.
explicit_snapshot: explicit-snapshot cells are a stress control: WAL growth while a snapshot is held is reported, not judged; release is covered by the final-checkpoint correctness rule.
validation_before_registration: Assessor applied to existing references (C_a,C_b as posts) => NO_CHANGE; (A,B as posts) => NO_CHANGE with one single-run noise row.
limits: No storage SLO exists; the bound is the observed reference envelope. No speed claim. Diagnostic PASSIVE run is not a control.
